[ REPUBLIC ACT NO. 6738, August 04, 1989 ]
AN ACT DECLARING MAY 5 OF EVERY YEAR AS OZAMIS DAY AND SPECIAL WORKING
HOLIDAY IN THE PROVINCE OF MISAMIS OCCIDENTAL AND ITS COMPONENT CITIES IN
HONOR OF THE LATE SENATOR JOSE F. OZAMIS.
